title: Motor-imagery protocol classification with fixed calibration
disposition_reason: Full54-person/two-session preparation, probability scoring, frozen-program and adaptive-investigation sources exist, but authentic108-recording preparation, runtime and reference fits remain unqualified. This is retrospective cued-protocol classification with an explicit software calibration allowance, not cue-independent intention or a20-trial closed-loop BCI.

scientific_target.question: How accurately can permitted EEG observations classify the recorded right-versus-left cued motor-imagery protocol under the first 20 same-session offline calibration-label allowance, relative to fixed context, permutation and calibration controls?
scientific_target.known_answer: Source protocol class right=1/left=0 for each of the 10,800 unique online trials, independently joined by the private generation/key mapping.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Observed original OpenBMI EEG_MI_train/EEG_MI_test class fields after full source/schema binding; labels are protocol instructions, not independently verified private intentions.
scientific_target.case_unit: One target person/session/setting/arm with100 queries; adaptive source uses100fresh per-query actors for each condition.
scientific_target.independent_unit: 54 people with two sessions each; donors recur across held-person contexts and conditions reuse online trials.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Retrospective decoding of cued imagery classes. The class arrow persists and online visual feedback came from the original100-trial calibrated classifier; a new20-label input allowance does not change those historical observations.
exclusions: No cue-independent or motor-specific physiological mechanism from accuracy alone.
No calibration-time reduction,20-trial closed-loop performance or future session forecast from bidirectional other-session transfer.
No multiplying 1,296 conditions or129,600investigations into new tasks/cohorts.

primary.name: target20/EEG person-macro session-macro balanced accuracy
primary.aggregation: Mean left/right recall for each100-trial session; equal two-session mean per person, then equal mean across54 people. p_right>=0.5 predicts right.
primary.rationale: Directly measures the intended recorded protocol-class target under the specific20-label condition without selective participant omission.

comparators.name: Independent prospective CSP/logvariance/shrinkage-LDA/Platt reference
comparators.inputs: Exactly20or100target calibration examples when available, otherwise10,600donor trials; train-only folds.
comparators.procedure: Freeze regularized generalized-eigen CSP/four extreme filters, ddof1logvariance, sklearn lsqr shrinkageauto equal-prior LDA, fivefold out-of-fold Platt map then refit. Support failures use (n_right+.5)/(n+1); numerical errors abstain. This source has not been fitted and differs from native MATLAB/BBCI.

comparators.inputs: Same query IDs and calibration policies; context-only features or deterministic within-person/session shuffled training labels.
comparators.procedure: Run unchanged learner/reference under each declared arm; permutation is a diagnostic, not a population p-value.
